sourceOccurrences.note: Karamata is stated with index strictly between zero and one and the Gamma normalization fixed. The Abelian implication is proved by a dyadic tail bound and dominated convergence; the converse uses polynomial approximation for tilted tail measures and monotonicity. No local point-mass equivalent is inferred.
